verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment is a fair question for a voice-agent API platform, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack never documents one. Related items do not count toward this story: A/B testing of reusable configurations, temporary tokens, regional endpoints and MIP data opt-out are adjacent controls, not an isolated environment separate from production data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
